global_rules.1: All scheduled jobs must be implemented as Python functions inside the Flask app.
global_rules.2: Each job must also have a corresponding Flask endpoint for manual triggering.
global_rules.3: Only the Master Market Data ingestion job may call external data sources.
global_rules.4: All other jobs must read exclusively from the Master Market Data DB.
global_rules.5: TurboMode.db is write-only for model outputs, predictions, drift logs, SHAP logs, and metadata.
global_rules.6: All jobs must log start, finish, and error states.
global_rules.7: All jobs must be idempotent and safe to re-run.
global_rules.8: APScheduler must be configured with a BackgroundScheduler and persistent job store if available.
global_rules.9: Jobs must run in the exact order defined by their dependencies.

scheduled_tasks.name: Master Market Data Ingestion|Daily
responsibilities: Fetch daily OHLCV, fundamentals, splits, dividends, and metadata.
Write updates to Master Market Data DB.
Do not write to TurboMode.db.
Log ingestion results.

scheduled_tasks.name: TurboMode Training Orchestrator|Weekly
responsibilities: Load symbols from Master Market Data DB.
Generate features and training samples.
Train models and save them to TurboMode.db.
Compute SHAP values and save logs.
Update model metadata and versioning.

scheduled_tasks.name: Morning Scanner|8AM-10AM
responsibilities: Run scanner every 3 minutes from 8:00-9:57 AM CST.
Load the latest trained model from TurboMode.db.
Generate real-time predictions for active trading.
Save signals and prediction metadata to TurboMode.db.

scheduled_tasks.name: Midday Scanner|10AM-2PM
responsibilities: Run scanner every 10 minutes from 10:00 AM-1:50 PM CST.
Runs at :00, :10, :20, :30, :40, :50 of each hour.
First run at 10:00 AM, last run at 1:50 PM (13:50).
3C takes over at 2:03 PM.
Load the latest trained model from TurboMode.db.
Generate real-time predictions for active trading.
Save signals and prediction metadata to TurboMode.db.

scheduled_tasks.name: Close Scanner|2PM-3PM
responsibilities: Run scanner every 3 minutes from 2:03-2:57 PM CST.
First run at 2:03 PM, last run at 2:57 PM.
Load the latest trained model from TurboMode.db.
Generate real-time predictions for active trading.
Save signals and prediction metadata to TurboMode.db.

scheduled_tasks.name: Overnight Scanner|Weekly
responsibilities: Run scanner Saturday night for Sunday trading prep.
Load the latest trained model from TurboMode.db.
Generate predictions for next trading week.
Save signals and prediction metadata to TurboMode.db.

scheduled_tasks.name: Backtest Generator|Weekly
responsibilities: Use Master Market Data DB to generate updated backtest datasets.
Save backtest results and metadata to TurboMode.db.
Ensure backtests reflect the latest ingestion.

scheduled_tasks.name: Adaptive Ranking|Weekly
responsibilities: Calculate risk-adjusted win rates (WIN_FRACTION = 3.0) from backtest data.
Apply directional fallback logic (pnl > 0 for BUY, pnl < 0 for SELL).
Generate composite scores with recency bias.
Produce top 10 ranked stocks list.
Save rankings to stock_rankings.json.

scheduled_tasks.name: Drift Monitor|Weekly
responsibilities: Compare today's feature distributions to historical baselines.
Detect regime shifts and log drift events.
Write drift logs to TurboMode.db.
Trigger retraining flags if drift exceeds thresholds.

scheduled_tasks.name: Weekly Maintenance|Weekly
responsibilities: VACUUM Master Market Data DB.
VACUUM TurboMode.db.
Clean temp directories.
Archive logs older than 30 days.
